title: File:Itanda Falls Entrance Sign – Where the River Roars.jpg
description: The image features the official entrance sign for the Itanda Falls Experience, set against a vibrant backdrop of sky and greenery. The sign includes an illustration of the roaring Nile rapids and the tagline: “Where the River Roars and the Heart Soars.” It also lists entrance fees for international (30,000 UGX or 10 USD) and national visitors (10,000 UGX or 3 USD), with a welcoming note that reads “Welcome Feel at Home.” Located in Eastern Uganda near Jinja, Itanda Falls is a popular destination
